feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 6 (±0.05 span, y=0.06, 16 mm, 0.12 m track, 0.035 m wheels, 0.6 kg) scored 51.67 with progress up on s-bend (0.157) and slalom (0.100), but it logged one line loss each on s-bend and slalom, and slalom steering_oscillation rose to 0.133. Iterations 0 to 5 show max_error pinned at 0.060 to 0.063 on every track whatever the span, footprint, track, radius, ki or mass, so the oval floor has not moved. I kept your controller unchanged so the span is the only variable. What to change next: if line_loss_events stay above 0 on s-bend or slalom at ±0.055, move the forward row back to y=0.045 with the same span, because the loss appeared only at y=0.06 and not at y=0.03 in iteration 5. If line losses clear and progress holds, try sensor_size 0.012 at y=0.06 with ±0.055 to test whether a smaller footprint moves the oval floor, since iteration 6 changed the footprint nowhere. If slalom steering_oscillation rises above about 0.15, do not change geometry first; the Integrator will retune kd.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events remain above 0 on s-bend or slalom with outer sensors at x=±0.055 and y=0.06, move the row to y=0.045 with the same span, because iteration 6 (y=0.06, ±0.05) logged one loss on each of those tracks while iteration 5 (y=0.03, ±0.05) logged none.

If line losses clear and progress holds at ±0.055, set sensor_size to 0.012 at y=0.06, because the oval max_error has stayed at 0.060 to 0.063 across every geometry change so far and this is the untested footprint lever.

If progress on s-bend or slalom falls below iteration 6 values (0.157 and 0.100), return the outer sensors to ±0.05 at y=0.06, because iteration 6 showed that this forward row is the lever that moved bend progress.
